prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 行标题 · 年度目标拆解 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "目标" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 108px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "截止" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 4: header "关键结果" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 541px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"将年度目标与负责人、截止日期和可衡量的关键结果对应起来，便于跟踪落实。","reading":"读者先按目标定位一行，再横向查看负责人、截止日期和关键结果；也可纵向比较各目标的责任人和时间安排。","groups":["目标与关键结果共同说明要达成什么及如何衡量，应保持清晰的行对应关系。","负责人与截止日期都是简短的执行信息，适合并列扫描，并应尽量完整显示。"],"keep_intact":["负责人姓名","截止日期及其连字符","关键结果中的数字、百分比和英文缩写"],"may_wrap":["目标名称可按中文语义自然换行，但应保持每行目标容易辨认。","关键结果是较长的描述性文字，可自然换行；目标名称也可利用这些文字形成的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [80, 67, 65, 147] · table 360×415px · row heights [36, 129, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [91, 67, 65, 136] · table 360×438px · row heights [36, 129, 106, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [85, 61, 65, 148] · table 360×438px · row heights [60, 129, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"负责人、截止日期和表头均完整显示；关键结果有较宽的阅读空间，各行对应关系清楚，表格也较紧凑。","problems":"部分目标名称被拆成较短的行，尤其“客户满意度提升”的末字单独占行；关键结果仍有较多换行。","cause":"目标列为80px，扣除内边距后不足以让较长目标形成更均衡的分行；关键结果列为147px，长句仍需多行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"目标列更宽，“组织建设”等名称更完整，目标更容易辨认；负责人、日期和表头均保持完整。","problems":"关键结果更拥挤，客户满意度和研发效能两行增加了换行，表格比r1A更高；部分目标仍然换行，因此增加的目标列宽没有带来一致的收益。","cause":"目标列增至91px，占用了关键结果列的11px，使其降至136px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"目标列比r1A稍宽，关键结果列也保有较好的阅读空间；日期和姓名完整，数据行高度与r1A相同。","problems":"“负责人”表头被拆成两行，抬高了整行表头并削弱并列执行信息的扫描节奏。","cause":"负责人列仅61px，扣除21px后不足以容纳46px宽的表头。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"结果优先","widths":[75,67,65,152],"change":"从r1A的目标列移出5px给关键结果列，保留完整的负责人表头和日期；检验更宽的结果列能否减少长句换行。"},{"name":"目标平衡","widths":[86,67,65,141],"change":"在r1A与r1B之间取值，增加目标列宽，同时保留比r1B更宽的关键结果列，检验目标辨认与结果行高之间的折中。"},{"name":"紧凑目标","widths":[70,67,65,157],"change":"进一步压缩目标列，把空间集中给关键结果；利用长结果形成的行高容纳目标换行，检验是否能改善整体阅读节奏。"}]}
